summary: Restore the checkpoint startup entrypoint and expose chain gate failures
details: Restore executable permissions on the paired checkpoint recovery script and invoke it through Bash in runtime Compose, including when using an existing services image.
Read Docker State for non-running containers to detect OCI execution failures hidden by Compose Created status, without reading container environments.
Show failed chain initialization, checkpoint recovery and control-plane startup ahead of managed restart intent, while preserving clean planned-stop handling.
Test actual script execution, mode-specific verification, created-container errors, failed gates, transient inspection failures and successful retries.
operator_actions: Use the updated node kit and reopen status --watch. Existing r15 installations can apply the scoped Compose and display fixes without reimporting snapshots or restarting upstream services.
Keep the checkpoint verification gate enabled; an active retrying controller resumes with the updated Compose entrypoint.
